title: Discovery of mikveh reveals unknown ancient Jewish settlement in southern Israel
description: The 25-ton ritual bath was extracted whole and moved so it could be preserved while a new neighborhood goes up in the city of Kiryat Gat

title: Scientists find evidence of ancient drug use in prehistoric teeth
description: A new study on ancient human remains finds evidence for the habitual use of betel nuts, dating back to the Ice Age. The finding offers some of the oldest archaeological evidence of psychoactive drug use, and potential insights into how use of betel nuts, now popular for their stimulant effects, evolved.
